The Anderson County General Sessions Court holds a pivotal role in the judicial system of Anderson County, Tennessee. It adjudicates a wide range of cases, from civil disputes to criminal offenses, and traffic violations.

What is a General Sessions Court?

General Sessions Court, as the name suggests, handles an array of legal cases. It's often the first stop for cases entering the judicial system, acting as the gateway to higher courts. Don't be mistaken, the 'General' in the name doesn't imply simplicity; cases handled here can be complex and significant.

Understanding the Jurisdiction of Anderson County General Sessions Court

In terms of jurisdiction, the Anderson County General Sessions Court can be seen as a triathlete, comfortably handling Criminal Cases, Civil Cases, and Traffic Violations.

Criminal Cases

The court takes care of preliminary hearings in felony cases, along with complete jurisdiction over misdemeanors.

Civil Cases

On the civil front, it deals with cases where the monetary dispute is under $25,000.

Traffic Violations

Traffic violations, from speeding to DUI, also fall under its umbrella.
